W. R. Plum via Paducah  Washn Jany 12th 1865 1030 AM
Grapes Elizabeth Flood for Lantern zebra Pandora Parsons has
gone Wilson to Super intend the wherry of Kisses
Pelham zodiac It is thought that Windsor whig as
far as the Ice will permit will be the
most comfortable forth whisky unity They will be taken
from Parkers burg to Ann apple is by Baptism
and Abner Welch if a sufficient number of cars
Canby obtained Pekin If not a part will go 
to Pitts burg zebra No Nuptial need be sent 
with out further orders yoke Italy very pleasant here


1. p. m.
Capt Sam Bruch  Washn Jany 12th 1865 
Growl Harriet Flood for Shelby Robert All in Dragon zebra
Paradise LB Parsons Stomach here last night for Dolphin
to take Shelter direction Torch whig of Kittens Pelton Saxon
Bethel to Cheese a peak bay Pekin just ordered by
John zodiac The Tablet will be made as far as
possible by boats from Ripley port unity If the state
of navigate shun will allow the whistle will not be
debarked till they reach Parkers burg Pedlar but if Tarquin
they will take the welch either at Bladder Pekin Evans
ville Pedlar Comb ville or Booby zebra Pandora Parsons can
not reach Dragon before Friday night Pekin mean while please
open any dispatches that may be addressed to him and
make all such arrangements respecting weasel boats as in your
